pit_by_coc.description: Point-in-Time (PIT) counts of people experiencing homelessness by Continuum of Care (CoC), one sheet per year 2007-2025 (2025 AHAR edition). Manual: huduser.gov refuses scripts; the user downloads the workbook and uploads it.

year.desc: the count year, i.e. the workbook sheet to read (2007-2025)

sheet.desc: a sheet name other than the year (the workbook's other sheets, e.g. a change table)

header_row.desc: the header row of the sheet, 1-based (default 1)

pit_by_state.description: PIT counts of people experiencing homelessness by state (and the national total), one sheet per year 2007-2025. Manual.

sheet.desc: a sheet name other than the year

hic_by_coc.description: Housing Inventory Count (HIC): beds and units for people experiencing homelessness (emergency shelter, transitional, safe haven, rapid re-housing, permanent supportive housing) by CoC, one sheet per year. Manual.

sheet.desc: a sheet name other than the year

hic_by_state.description: Housing Inventory Count by state, one sheet per year. Manual.

sheet.desc: a sheet name other than the year

veterans_by_coc.description: PIT counts of veterans experiencing homelessness by CoC, one sheet per year 2011-2025. Manual.

sheet.desc: a sheet name other than the year

veterans_by_state.description: PIT counts of veterans experiencing homelessness by state, one sheet per year 2011-2025. Manual.

sheet.desc: a sheet name other than the year
